requirements: Indexing scale: pilot 1.5M docs -> prod target 120M docs (avg 1.2k tokens per doc)
Embedding store: per-shard capacity planning, vector dim 768-1024, need on-disk compression and fast NN (IVF/HNSW) with warm cache
Reranking: top-100 candidates, model latency budget 50-120ms depending on hardware; prefer quantized int8/4 runtime
Per-language targets: EN/ES recall >= 92% at top-10, FR/DE recall >= 88% (goal), low-resource languages baseline >= 75%
Throughput: expected 5k qps peak for EU legal teams in steady-state; pilot <200 qps
Latency SLOs: p95 end-to-end search (embedding + candidate retrieval + rerank) <= 350ms (EN/ES), <=500ms for other languages
Cost goal: pilot <$0.12/query; steady-state <$0.05/query with caching/batching
Security: VPC deployment, per-tenant KMS keys, audit logs retained 1 year (expandable), SSO via SAML
Model governance: immutable eval sets, per-release regression alerts, explainability metadata for reranker decisions
Fallbacks: lightweight lexical fallback (BM25) for languages with low embedding coverage; automatic model variant routing
